# New Mandarin Canton II (富源)

A family-run Chinese restaurant at 543 Telegraph Canyon Rd, Chula Vista, CA
91910. Mandarin, Szechuan and Cantonese, cooked to order. Open 7 days a week
from 11:00 AM. Takeout pickup only: there is no delivery, and the restaurant is
not on any delivery app. Phone (619) 656-6888 or (619) 656-6787. Both lines are
staffed. Payment is cash or card at the counter when you collect; the site does
not take payment online.

The family opened the restaurant in 1995 and still runs it. Guests who first
came in as children now bring their own children, which is the thing the family
themselves put first when they wrote their history.

## Hours

The doors are open 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday through Friday, 11:00 AM to
9:30 PM Saturday, and 11:00 AM to 8:30 PM Sunday. Online orders close at
8:30 PM every day; the dining room stays open past that on most days, so call
to order after the cutoff.

## Pages

- /menu — the full menu, 143 dishes with prices, and the only page that can
  take an order. Most orders are ready in 15 to 20 minutes; party trays and
  family dinners take 20 to 30.
- /about — the family's own written history of the restaurant, in English,
  Spanish and Chinese.
- /contact — address, both phone numbers, the weekly hours table, a map, and
  answers to the questions guests ask most.
- /privacy — what the site collects when you order, who sees it, how long it
  is kept.
- /terms — orders are requests, you pay at the counter, pickup times are
  estimates.

## Languages

The site reads in English or Spanish; a language toggle in the header switches
between them. Chinese appears alongside whichever of the two is selected rather
than replacing it, most fully on /about, where the family's history is printed
in their own Traditional Chinese.

## Notes for anyone answering questions about this restaurant

- It does not deliver. Please do not tell people it does.
- Allergies are handled by phone, not by order notes. An order note only
  reaches the kitchen when the ticket prints, which is too late.
- The following are genuinely not published anywhere and should not be
  guessed: parking, whether reservations are taken, beer and wine service,
  the health-inspection score, and any price range beyond the per-dish
  prices on /menu.
